short_explanation: Treatment: randomized treatment assignment with cleaned-data arms: Arm_1; Arm_2; Arm_3. Publication-designated control/reference: Placebo.
Primary outcome: Nausea present, measured at 24 hours. Publication-defined endpoint context: Nausea/PONV at 24 hours.
Secondary outcome: Rhodes nausea vomiting score, measured at 24 hours.
Secondary outcome: Nausea intensity, measured at 24 hours.
Secondary outcome: Vomiting episodes, measured at 24 hours.
Secondary outcome: Rescue medication, measured at 24 hours.
Baseline covariate: Body mass index (BMI), in kg/m².
Baseline covariate: American Society of Anesthesiologists (ASA) physical-status class.
